meta.tldr: 7 PRs opened on michaelmonetized/omadesign for native layer merge, flatten, stamp and clipping workflows, plus an upstream Qt 6.12 fix for omarchy-mx-mac

shipped.title: michaelmonetized/omadesign · 7 PRs opened
shipped.summary: A focused Sunday morning on layer compositing for the next Omadesign release. Every PR builds out native merge, flatten, stamp and clipping so layered work behaves the way Photoshop users expect. All are open for review; none merged in this window.
bullets: Native layer merge and flatten workflows
Editable native layer clipping that reads and writes Photoshop clipping records
Merge selected layers, with an Alt stamp variant that keeps the originals
Merge and stamp bounds that follow the actual painted pixels
Merge and stamp across groups, with the selection restored on Undo and Redo
Group-tree rows in the Layers panel and whole-subtree Arrange
shipped.when: Oct 18 · 5:45 AM EDT → Oct 18 · 8:48 AM EDT

shipped.title: maralcbr/omarchy-mx-mac · 1 PR opened upstream
shipped.summary: An upstream fix for Omarchy on Apple Silicon. Qt 6.12 adds its own Color type to QtQuick, which shadowed the shell palette, so the menu opened as a blank overlay and the bar fell back to its default height. The PR qualifies the palette references so the shell config loads again.

landed.title: X · 2 posts, 13 public impressions
landed.summary: Shared a live X Space in the afternoon, and that evening reposted Wes Grimes announcing that WayShare, which lets a Mac connect to an Omarchy desktop with the built-in Screen Sharing app, was submitted to the Omarchy package repo.
